title: AngMar Companies
description: AngMar is a private organization comprised of numerous corporate holdings, LLCs, and companies, operating a network of home health care facilities. They disregard the safety of their clients and the people they care for. As a result, 710 GB of confidential information about the companies they serve has been exposed. Most importantly, patient data has been leaked, including their medical records, medical histories, personal information such as Social Security numbers, home addresses and phone numbers, and much more.
